verdict.rationale: Braintrust documents a REST API, described as covering "all aspects of the Braintrust platform," backed by a published OpenAPI 3.1.1 spec. The API is documented for projects, experiments, datasets, traces, prompts, tools and scorers, and the official SDKs, `bt` CLI and MCP server extend programmatic access. However, the evidence never shows that UI-only surfaces (playgrounds, Loop, Patterns, Topics, custom annotation interfaces, dashboards) are reachable through the API, so full UI parity is claimed but not demonstrated. missing for 10: documented API coverage of playgrounds, Loop/Patterns/Topics, annotation interfaces and dashboards; an explicit UI-to-API parity mapping; independent hands-on corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Braintrust API allows you to interact with all aspects of the Braintrust platform programmatically.
You can use it to: Create and manage projects, experiments, and datasets; Log traces and metrics; Manage prompts, tools, and scorers
The API is defined by an OpenAPI 3.1.1 specification published at braintrust-openapi on GitHub.
It lets you authenticate, trace coding-agent sessions, run evals, browse and query logs, sync data, and manage functions without leaving your terminal.
